newsitem.title: USA: Home Link faces shareholder lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Home Link faces shareholder lawsuit.

text.p: Home Link Corp shareholders filed a class action suit against the company and two of its officers Tuesday, alleging they misled shareholders and artifically boosted Home Link's stock price, plaintiff lawyers said.

The suit, filed in U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida, alleges the company and executives Marlon Matson and Phyllis Reff issued "false and misleading statements regarding, among other things, Home Link's assets, financial statements, business prospects and expected revenues."
Home Link could not be reached for comment.
